name: Eyantra Ventures Limited
about: Eyantra Ventures Limited provides custom merchandise solutions in India and internationally. The company offers corporate gifting; software services, including artificial intelligence, software engineering, and mobile application; and advanced embedded and internet of things (IoT) solutions, such as embedded software and hardware solutions. It also provides cutting-edge spine solutions, orthopedics, neurosciences, and lifesaving critical care solutions. The company was formerly known as Punit Commercials Limited and changed its name to Eyantra Ventures Limited in November 2022. Eyantra Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
